Let
\[
A_n=\int_{[0,1]^4}e^{-nT^2}\,d\mathbf x,\qquad B_n=I_n(0).
\]
Then
\[
I_n(\lambda)=A_n\sinh\lambda+B_n,
\]
so the unique root is
\[
\lambda_n=\operatorname{arsinh}\!\left(-\frac{B_n}{A_n}\right).
\]

For any suitable \(f\),
\[
\int_{[0,1]^4}f(x_1x_2x_3x_4)\,d\mathbf x
=\frac16\int_0^1 f(t)(-\log t)^3\,dt,
\]
because if \(u_i=-\log x_i\), then \(T=e^{-(u_1+\cdots+u_4)}\), and \(u_1+\cdots+u_4\) has density \(s^3e^{-s}/6\).

First,
\[
A_n=\frac16\int_0^1 e^{-nt^2}(-\log t)^3\,dt.
\]
With \(u=\sqrt n\,t\),
\[
A_n\sim \frac{n^{-1/2}}6\left(\frac{\log n}{2}\right)^3\int_0^\infty e^{-u^2}\,du
=\frac{\sqrt\pi}{96}n^{-1/2}(\log n)^3.
\]

Now put \(m=n^{1/3}\), \(\delta=n^{-1/12}=m^{-1/4}\), and
\[
b_j=(2n)^{1/3}2^j.
\]
For the \(j\)-th term, substitute \(y=b_jt\). Since
\[
\frac{(-1)^{3-j}\binom3j2^j}{b_j}
=(-1)^{3-j}\binom3j(2n)^{-1/3},
\]
we get, up to exponentially negligible upper-limit errors,
\[
B_n=\frac{n^{1/12}(2n)^{-1/3}}6
\int_0^\infty Q_n(y)
\sum_{j=0}^3(-1)^{3-j}\binom3j(\log b_j-\log y)^3\,dy,
\]
where
\[
Q_n(y)=e^{-m[4+(y-\delta)^4]}
+e^{-m[4+(y+\delta)^4]}
-2e^{-m[4+y^4+y^8]}.
\]
Since \(\log b_j=\frac13\log(2n)+j\log2\), the third finite difference gives
\[
\sum_{j=0}^3(-1)^{3-j}\binom3j(\log b_j-\log y)^3
=6(\log2)^3.
\]
Hence
\[
B_n=n^{1/12}(2n)^{-1/3}(\log2)^3\int_0^\infty Q_n(y)\,dy.
\]

Now set \(y=\delta z\). Because \(m\delta^4=1\) and \(m\delta^8=m^{-1}\),
\[
\int_0^\infty Q_n(y)\,dy
=e^{-4m}\delta H(m^{-1}),
\]
where
\[
H(\varepsilon)=\int_0^\infty
\left(e^{-(z-1)^4}+e^{-(z+1)^4}-2e^{-z^4-\varepsilon z^8}\right)\,dz.
\]
At \(\varepsilon=0\),
\[
H(0)=0,
\]
because
\[
\int_0^\infty e^{-(z-1)^4}dz+\int_0^\infty e^{-(z+1)^4}dz
=2\int_0^\infty e^{-z^4}dz.
\]
Also
\[
H'(0)=2\int_0^\infty z^8e^{-z^4}\,dz
=\frac12\Gamma\!\left(\frac94\right).
\]
Therefore
\[
\int_0^\infty Q_n(y)\,dy
\sim \frac12\Gamma\!\left(\frac94\right)e^{-4n^{1/3}}n^{-5/12}.
\]
Thus
\[
B_n\sim 2^{-4/3}\Gamma\!\left(\frac94\right)(\log2)^3
\,n^{-2/3}e^{-4n^{1/3}}.
\]

Since \(B_n/A_n\to0\),
\[
\lambda_n\sim-\frac{B_n}{A_n}
\sim
-\frac{96}{\sqrt\pi}2^{-4/3}\Gamma\!\left(\frac94\right)(\log2)^3
\,n^{-1/6}(\log n)^{-3}e^{-4n^{1/3}}.
\]
Using \(\Gamma(9/4)=\frac5{16}\Gamma(1/4)\), the constant is
\[
L=-30\,2^{-4/3}\frac{\Gamma(1/4)}{\sqrt\pi}(\log2)^3.
\]

Therefore
\[
\boxed{\alpha=\frac16,\quad \beta=3,\quad c=4,\quad
L=-30\,2^{-4/3}\frac{\Gamma(1/4)}{\sqrt\pi}(\log2)^3.}
\]
